column1: # Derived from the Lancaster Sensorimotor Norms (Lynott, Connell, Brysbaert, Brand & Carney, 2020),
# licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: single words only,
# lowercased; only words whose strongest perceptual modality rates at least 4.0 and leads the
# next modality by at least 1.0; columns reduced to the dominant modality (v visual, a auditory,
# h haptic, o olfactory, g gustatory, i interoceptive), its mean strength and its lead over the
# second modality, both in tenths of a rating point (0-50). Built by scripts/build-lancaster-norms.py.
